Exclusive: Read full interview of Raj Thackeray to Rajat Sharma in 'Aap Ki Adalat' (Part 1). ## New Delhi: In an exclusive interview to India TV Editor-in-chief Rahjat Sharma on his popular ‘Aap Ki Adalat' show, MNS chief Raj Thackeray for the first time publically expressed his desire of becoming Chief Minister. exclusive read full interview of raj thackeray to rajat sharma in aap ki adalat part 1 Image Source : INDIATV. **New Delhi:** In an exclusive interview to India TV Editor-in-chief Rahjat Sharma on his popular ‘Aap Ki Adalat' show, MNS chief Raj Thackeray for the first time publically expressed his desire of becoming Chief Minister of Maharashtra in case his party gets a majority in the assembly. In a no- holds- barred interview with Rajat Sharma, Raj Thackeray opened up on a range of issues from his perceived disdain for North Indians ,his relations with Bal Thackeray and Uddhav Thackeray as well as his unsolicited support to BJP prime ministerial candidate Narendra Modi.
